sft_candidate_construction.single_intent: gold tool plus 1-4 same-domain distractor tools
sft_candidate_construction.multi_candidate_order: randomize the ordered GT trajectory within dependency-valid topological orders, then independently shuffle candidate display order away from the GT order; the gold tool set is unchanged
sft_candidate_construction.multi_distractors: gold tools plus 1-3 same-domain distractors, total candidates at most 5

official_test.novelty_scope: Independent API language and source-trace holdout inside a fixed 100-tool taxonomy; target tool sets/sequences are disclosed separately and are not required to be unseen.

dpo.scaling_policy: Keep the PDF upper bound of 5k rather than multiplying preference pairs by 6: DPO pairs are mined hard errors, not independent query coverage rows; quality, source traceability, and at most two negatives per query take precedence over uniform row-count scaling.
dpo.preference_source: 5000 audited real model generations; no API-generated or rule-generated negative was used

scope: static ordered tool-ID trajectories; no claim of tool execution
